interfaceInvariant: Theorem lineage is ordinary public Ladon CLI behavior shared by people, scripts, editors, and models; no caller-specific command, default, threshold, or evidence path is permitted.
authorityInvariant: Only a complete compatible theorem-capsule semanticGraph with lean_environment authority establishes actual compiled-proof lineage. The SQLite database persists and queries that evidence but does not elaborate or independently prove it.
databaseInvariant: All lineage rows live in the existing repository-local proof-search SQLite database or its explicit --index override. The alpha schema is private, constrained, indexed in both traversal directions, freshness-scoped, and transactionally replaceable.
algorithmInvariant: SQLite owns closure selection, reachability, filtering, minimum-depth selection, representative routes, source joins, and relational projections. Pure algorithms are limited to bounded SCC-condensed dominators and reference-preserving tree unfolding.
nonclaimInvariant: Lineage describes dependencies of one compiled theorem value and its type. It does not enumerate possible alternative proofs, establish a unique proof tree, explain the mathematics, or act as an independent proof checker.

dependencySemantics.startAfter: The named child begins only after every listed standalone child passes its portable exit class.
dependencySemantics.integrationDependsOn: Existing owner changes whose established authority or lifecycle this child reuses.
dependencySemantics.enables: Later child changes allowed to start after this child's portable exit class passes.

existingOwners.ownedConcern: complete exact theorem identity and semantic dependency stream
repository-local SQLite lifecycle, schema checks, freshness, and size cap
declaration source ranges and project/module ownership
Lean helper supervision, timeouts, signals, and process-tree limits
installed process, stream, representation, and exit behavior

acceptanceScenarios: fresh complete theorem plan ingested transactionally
shared-node tree references and SCC termination
fresh database hit without Lean execution
retainedExternalLanes: possible alternative proof search owned by proof-discovery work
automatic theorem proving or proof repair
